Resolves #21057

🌿 A claim can no longer go unanswered because of the apostrophe its keyboard typed.

`claimText()` now folds the four apostrophe look-alikes (’ U+2019, ‘ U+2018, ʼ U+02BC, ´ U+00B4) to `'` before the claim and withdrawal patterns run. A claim typed with smart punctuation gets its reply and assignment, and a withdrawal typed the same way frees the issue. The #20670 comment that went unanswered now reads as a claim.

Evidence: L2 (spec rows on the pure functions, plus a replay of the real #20670 comment) → L2 required (every AC is a unit-level statement about `isClaim`, `isWithdrawal` and `claimText`). No residuals.

Micro-review eligible: contained fix — one fold at the single read point, plus spec rows.

Intake (self-authored this session). Prescription checked: `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` (`claimText`) owns the concern. It is the one read point for `isClaim` and `isWithdrawal`, and no apostrophe normaliser exists in `buildScripts`, `.github`, `src/util` or `ai/services` (a grep with a control: ’ occurs in 24 tracked files). `normalize('NFKC')` is no substitute: it leaves U+2018, U+2019 and U+02BC as they are and splits U+00B4 into a space plus a combining accent.

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. The set is written as code points (`/[\u{2018}\u{2019}\u{2BC}\u{B4}]/gu`), so the four look-alikes stay tellable apart in review.

## Test Evidence

Outside CI:
- **Red-proof on the unfixed module**, each new test run alone with `-g`: the claim test failed on `claimText` returning `I’d like to take this.` unchanged, and the withdrawal test failed with `isWithdrawal` false. A replay of all eight positive rows read false on `dev` @ `d5530ef461`.
- **The real specimen:** the #20670 comment, fetched through the API and passed to `isClaim`, reads `false` on `dev` and `true` on this branch.
- **The whole unit suite** passed locally (7409 passed, 2 skipped) while the set was still spelled as literal glyphs. Spelling it as code points changed no member, and on this head `claimResponse.spec.mjs` and `contributorStanding.spec.mjs` pass 73/73.
